name: Raskajanie
source:
A novel about life, what it is and what it can be. In any case, the choice is yours, what will come to your liking, that will become for you the life that you personally want to live.

[Translated from [url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/10-1-0-588]Anivisual[/url]]
translation:
一本关于生活、生活是什么以及它可以是什么的小说。无论如何，选择权在你，你会喜欢什么，什么就会成为你个人想要的生活。

[译自[url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/10-1-0-588]Anivis[/url]]
